pages.text: Upgraded Crafting Processor$(br)Modular design. Structures of different tiers are identical, only the component tiers differ, so the installation method is universal.$(br)Look up the controller recipe in JEI; you can see the structure diagram in the 'Structure Preview' section.$(br)After adjusting to the appropriate size, click 'Project to World'.
$(6)Note: Maximum size is 12, and most blocks have orientation requirements.

pages.text1: After construction is complete, hold the Storage Matrix and SHIFT right-click the LD to install it.
pages.text2: This block is used to connect AE cables, allowing EL to interface with AE just like a drive.
